profile.name: Kennys Alfaro
profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer · C# / .NET 8-9 · Microservices · Azure & AWS
profile.summary: I build and maintain backend systems in the .NET ecosystem, mostly where many systems have to talk to each other reliably: third-party provider integrations, asynchronous processing, cloud functions and message queues. I've worked across finance, legal tech, electronic invoicing, hospitality, education and government, in Agile/Scrum teams, with a strong habit of unit testing, code reviews and production troubleshooting.

highlights: Develop and maintain backend features based on customer and business requirements.
Build backend solutions with C# and .NET 8/9 in a microservices-oriented environment.
Integrate hotel inventory services with Sabre, Amadeus, Travco, HotelBeds and DerbySoft through REST and SOAP APIs.
Develop Azure Functions for backend processing and serverless workloads.
Implement and maintain Hangfire background jobs for asynchronous and scheduled processing.
Work with MongoDB for data persistence and backend operations.
Investigate and troubleshoot issues across development, testing and production; analyze provider behavior to find root causes.
Write unit tests, maintain code coverage and take part in code reviews.
Developed backend features according to customer requirements.
Implemented AWS Lambda functions for AI-powered text summarization.
Built an AI summarization solution integrating backend services with cloud technologies.
Implemented unit testing and maintained code coverage in a microservices architecture and Agile/Scrum environment.
Developed new backend features according to customer requirements.
Worked with Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus and Azure Storage in microservices-based solutions.
Conducted technical workshops to share knowledge and improve team productivity.
Implemented unit testing and maintained code coverage.
Provided technical support following production deployments.
Investigated and resolved application incidents.
Supported production stability and issue resolution.
Developed new features for MiFactoring, an electronic invoicing platform.
Developed backend functionality using C# and .NET Core.
Applied SOLID principles and design patterns.
